versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-video-to-text.

- Extracts clean transcriptions from video files or online video links, removing filler words, errors, and repetitions.
- Supports custom prompts for summary, rewriting (e.g., Xiaohongshu/Douyin style), extracting highlights, translating to English, and more.
- Command-line tool with simple options; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for use.
- Ensures privacy: video content only sent to guaikei.com, deleted after processing.
- Not suitable for live streams or encrypted/login-protected videos.
- Outputs refined text ready for reuse in creative and business scenarios.
